## Profile

Mahmoud Selim is an Associate Professor at the Faculty of Engineering, Alamein International University (AIU), Egypt. His research focuses on intelligent wireless systems for smart cities and next-generation networks, with particular interests in integrated sensing and communications, UAV-assisted communications, RIS-assisted communications, IoT and wireless sensor networks, NOMA, B5G/6G enabling technologies, signal processing, and radio resource allocation.

He has held research appointments at the University of Padova, Italy, Shenzhen University, China, and Kyushu University, Japan. He earned his PhD and MSc in Electronics and Communications Engineering from the Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology (E-JUST), and his BSc from Tanta University.
